title: Platforms Overview
meta_description: The Achala platform portfolio: eight licensed products from our R&D programme and eight production platforms running client operations today.

blocks.x: Achala builds platforms for the decisions enterprises make at scale. Eight come from our own R&D programme and license as products; another eight run in production today for clients in healthcare, mobility, public sector and finance.
The platform suite from our R&D programme

Eight platforms, each built on a patented method family from our R&D programme and licensed as a product: decision intelligence, data engineering, agent orchestration, zero-trust security, digital twin operations, advanced compute, distributed trust and AI governance. They deploy under NDA, run on your infrastructure, and produce the evidence your auditors ask for.

Eight production platforms run client operations every day: emergency response across 9 states, fleet management, KYC verification in about 5 minutes, telemedicine, queue management, patient portals, BI and analytics, and assistive smart glasses. Each one carries a published client result.

Most engagements begin with a 45-minute briefing on one use case. We configure the platform against your data, agree the metric it will be measured on, and scope the pilot in writing before delivery starts.
Book a briefing with the platform team. Bring one use case, we will show it running on the platform and leave you with a written feasibility read.
